title: Bumper: Headline / Rekt Meter
mood: the meter fills, then the motif's tail falls
description: Segment bumper for Headline / Rekt Meter, built from Zoo's motif (3.2 s).
usage: Cut on the downbeat at the segment change: the file starts with two frames of silence, so start it at downbeatStartFrame(cue, cutFrame) (2 frames early). The music is finished before the file ends. -16 LUFS-I.
selfReview: The meter fills (taps, rising pizzicato and air), then the motif's tail A, Ab, F falls with band stabs and a crash. Critic round 1 (2026-11-24): the synth brass came down to -9 dB and VSCO 2 violas (fast bowing) double the stabs at -6 dB; on the landing the brass now sits 16.8 dB under the mix (8.4 before), the violas carry the stab (10 dB under the mix, 5.9 dB on the phone model) and the kick is 13.1 dB under (4.6 before). The 1.2 s fill may feel rushed at 100 BPM; that needs an ear. Critic round 2 (2026-11-24): release-ready; re-rendered with the shared fixes (measured tuning, the decaying FingerBass, one kick tuning, the band compressors, the -1.5 dBTP sting ceiling). Master limiter 2.90 dB at most; -1.5 dBTP after AAC 128k (worst of ten), -1.6 dBTP after Opus 128k.
